items.title: Eblen Rau Interview, 1974-05-27
items.q: But he also had a nice sense of humor. He could tell these funny stories that went along with our type of entertainment there.

ctx.x: And he had a good ear for changes? Yeah, he had a good ear.

But he also had a nice sense of humor. He could tell these funny stories that went along with our type of entertainment there. But if I'm not mistaken, Fritz at that time was playing the banjo or some kind of makeshift banjo, banjo mandolin or something, I don't know what the hell they called it. I don't think it was a straight banjo. That was the little Frenchman played the banjo. Oh, I know who you're talking about. Five string, a four string, a six string? I think he had a six string. He could play a damn…
Was this before Rene Jelpie or after him?
